name: Pennsylvania
sources: Flat 3.07% on each class of income, no standard deduction, itemized deductions or personal exemptions: 72 P.S. 7302 (Tax Reform Code of 1971, as amended 2004); Pennsylvania Department of Revenue, Personal Income Tax (revenue.pa.gov/PIT)
notes: Local earned income tax on wages and self-employment income (commonly 1-2%, 3.75% in Philadelphia) is not included.
Pennsylvania's Tax Forgiveness for low incomes and the Working Pennsylvanians Tax Credit are not included.
